scope: New source-only policy comparison motivated by closed FIT109 diagnostics. Existing head and fold unchanged.

arms.T: Fixed cutoff 3/7, chosen to correspond to IoU .75
arms.R: Maximize ratio of expected intersection to expected union over all attainable sign counts at locked edits

pseudo_label: Foreground probability from the same learned PointRend RoI, fixed paste crop plus 1px halo and zero outside, no target data read. Candidate P0 keeps full original area; I0 sums posterior over stock pixels, T sums posterior over crop, all endpoint posterior mass in same support.
preconditions: Verify byte-identical old matched edit choices before new evaluation. Every non-stock policy keeps the same candidate order, scores, endpoints and exact 2k edits.
